definitions.explanation: One of the most common Japanese surnames, literally meaning 'in the rice field.'

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}⟦{夫妻|ふさい}→夫妻：00047_fusai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招待|しょうたい}→招待：01435_shoutai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I invited the Tanakas (Mr. and Mrs. Tanaka).

examples.japanese: {田中|たなか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧{名字|みょうじ}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Tanaka is a common surname in Japan.

notes:
{田中|たなか} is one of the most common Japanese surnames, typically ranked around 4th most common in Japan.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{田|た}→田：03380_ta⟧: rice field
- ⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧: middle, inside
- Literally: "in the rice field," suggesting ancestors who lived among rice paddies

USAGE:
As one of the most recognizable surnames, {田中|たなか} is frequently used as a placeholder name in examples, forms, and textbooks.

COMMON JAPANESE SURNAMES:
- ⟦{佐藤|さとう}→佐藤：27597_satou⟧: Satō (most common)
- ⟦{鈴木|すずき}→鈴木：09530_suzuki⟧: Suzuki
- {高橋|たかはし}: Takahashi
- ⟦{山田|やまだ}→山田：09529_yamada⟧: Yamada
